evidence_title: Printing Production, May 1959 (Vol. 89, Iss. 8), News Items
evidence_quote: New Distributor for Polychrome—Westco Litho Products Co., 1402 Sunset Blvd., Los Angeles, has been appointed exclusive distributor of Polychrome products in Southern California
researcher_notes: Trade journal (graphic arts). Ties Polychrome products to 1402 Sunset one year before the 1960 listing; the source names the distributor (Westco Litho Products Co.), not Polychrome Corp itself, so the 1960-65 'Polychrome Corp' listing is read as the same supply operation under the maker's name. The Office, March 1961 (archive.org/details/sim_office_1961-03_53_3, 'OFFSET INKS' item) describes Polychrome Corp., 2 Ashburton Ave., Yonkers NY, introducing lithographic inks, i.e. a graphic-arts supply maker. Wholesale distribution -> Light industrial, trades & wholesale.
